**Comparability note:** Both figures are drawn from the same 10-K on a consistent basis (no segment redefinition or divestiture involved), so the ratios are directly comparable. One minor caveat: Apple's fiscal 2023 was a 53-week year while fiscal 2024 was a 52-week year, so the revenue denominators cover slightly different lengths of time — the extra week modestly inflates FY2023 revenue and thus slightly understates the FY2023 ratio's comparability to FY2024.

**Calculation:** 31,370 / 391,035 = 8.022%; 29,915 / 383,285 = 7.805%; difference = +0.217 pp. The increase was driven by R&D growing ~4.9% versus revenue growth of only ~2.0%.

ANSWER: Increased — by approximately 0.22 percentage points (from ~7.80% in FY2023 to ~8.02% in FY2024)
